subject.title: Discord plugin: channels added to channels.discord.guilds.*.channels.* post-startup are never subscribed (requires full gateway restart)

question: Is the current source-level `channels.discord` restart path enough to start implementation, or should this wait for live/focused reproduction of the add-channel-while-running Discord flow?
rationale: The source shows the intended reload path exists, but the reported release behavior says inbound still failed after config edit; without proof of the missed link, an automated fix would be guessing across Discord provider, gateway reload, and config watcher boundaries.

options.title: Require focused reproduction first
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for live Discord logs or a focused integration proof that identifies where the configured new channel fails to reach provider restart or inbound preflight.

options.title: Start a source-level investigation
options.body: Allow a maintainer-owned investigation PR to instrument or test the reload path without committing to a product behavior change yet.

options.title: Fold into dynamic allowlist work
options.body: Treat the operator workflow as part of the broader pattern/category allowlist feature, leaving the exact reload bug unaddressed until that product direction lands.

recommendation.title: Require focused reproduction first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for live Discord logs or a focused integration proof that identifies where the configured new channel fails to reach provider restart or inbound preflight.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant owner signal is repeated recent Discord provider and allowlist work, and this decision hinges on whether the Discord-specific runtime path has enough proof to repair.
